category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle in a locked classroom during the first session, where the goal is to listen to the facilitator read a short text to initiate a dialogue.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Welcome to our first session. Now that we are all sitting in a circle, I am going to read this short text out loud so we can start our dialogue.

STUDENT: Do we really have to do this? I don't want to listen to a story.

TUTOR: Let's just try to get through the first page together.

STUDENT: (Looks around the room, ignoring the text) This is taking forever. Hey, what are we having for lunch today?

TUTOR: Please focus on the reading for now.

STUDENT: (Turns completely away from the tutor to face another participant) I'm not listening to this. Hey, did you hear what happened in the yard earlier? This is so boring.

options.A: Provide the student with a pressure vest as a sensory accommodation during the reading activity.
options.B: Require the student to remain in the circle, providing brief redirection if disruption occurs.
options.C: Ask the student to think of a question they would like to discuss about the text.
options.D: Tell the student they may leave the classroom right now or the police will be called.
